d: Trade unions and farmers’ organisations have demanded that Prime Minister Narendra Modi apologise to the nation over the shortfall in the Make in India initiative and the Viksit Bharat 2047 vision. The Samyukt Kisan Morcha (SKM) and the Centre of Indian Trade Unions (CITU) criticised the government's economic policies, accusing it of favouring corporate houses through tax concessions and incentives. The organisations also pointed to rising unemployment and inequality, and called for a shift in economic policy, including higher taxes on the super-rich and corporate profits.
